name: Big n BLD Finprov 2024
information:
* The competition is happening at the 2nd floor of the Complex
* Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late.
* All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, please go through the WCA regulations
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well.
* Participants must bring their own cubes.
* Food is strictly prohibited in the venue
